title: Monster Bites
description: Silly apple mouths contain peanut butter and yellow candy corn teeth. So quick and easy that the kids can help assemble them.
ingredients: 4 apples, cored and cut into 8 wedges
0.5 cup candy corn, or as needed

steps.text: Slice each wedge of apple in half the long way, making two smaller wedges. Spread about 3/4 teaspoon of peanut butter on one cut side of a small wedge, and place 5 or 6 pieces of candy corn sticking out of the peanut butter for teeth. Spread 3/4 teaspoon of peanut butter onto the cut side of second small wedge. Lightly press second wedge to the tops of the candy corn teeth, with the peanut butter to the inside, to form lips. Repeat with remaining apples, peanut butter, and candy corn.
